text:
PSRR and CMRR fail because the first-stage mirror does not match the second stage. M3's Vgs (1.163 V) differs from M7's Vgs (1.118 V), which is why `gmid4` and `gmid7` dominate the sensitivities. The tail transistor also has only 93 mV of margin above Vdsat, so its output resistance is low (gm/gds about 51).

The edit forces M7 to the same L as M3/M4 and makes Vgs3 equal Vgs7 by bisection. It also lengthens the tail and raises its gm/Id to gain headroom.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Systematic Vgs3≠Vgs7 imbalance limits PSRR/CMRR (gmid4/gmid7 sensitivities). Tie M7 L to mirror, solve M3/M4 gm/Id so Vgs3=Vgs7 exactly; increase tail rout via longer Lb, higher gm/Id bias and higher input gm/Id for more tail Vds."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # diff pair L
    "itail": (8e-6, 5e-6, 12e-6),    # tail current
    "L4":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # PMOS mirror L (also 2nd stage L)
    "gmid7": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # 2nd stage PMOS gm/Id
    "i7":    (28e-6, 18e-6, 34e-6),  # 2nd stage current
    "cc":    (1.2e-12, 0.7e-12, 2.0e-12),
    "rz_k":  (1.3, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = rz_k*(1+CL/Cc)/gm7
    "Lb":    (3.0, 1.5, 4.0),        # bias/tail/M8 L
    "gb":    (16.0, 12.0, 19.0),     # bias gm/Id
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = spec.get("vdd", 1.8); vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    it, i1, i7, cc = p["itail"], p["itail"] / 2, p["i7"], p["cc"]
    L4 = p["L4"]

    # ---- bias ----
    gb, Lb = p["gb"], p["Lb"]
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, iref, vds=0.65)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, iref, vds=mb0.vgs)

    # ---- second stage PMOS (same L as mirror) ----
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], L4, i7, vds=vdd - vcm)
    vout1 = vdd - m7.vgs

    # ---- mirror: choose gm/Id so Vgs3 == Vgs7 (no systematic imbalance) ----
    lo, hi = 5.0, 22.0
    for _ in range(30):
        g = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        m3 = lut.size("p", g, L4, i1, vds=m7.vgs)
        if m3.vgs > m7.vgs:
            lo = g
        else:
            hi = g
    g3 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    m3 = lut.size("p", g3, L4, i1, vds=m7.vgs)
    m4 = lut.size("p", g3, L4, i1, vds=vdd - vout1)
    vn1 = vdd - m3.vgs

    # ---- diff pair (with body effect) ----
    vs = 0.25
    for _ in range(5):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=max(vn1 - vs, 0.1), vsb=vs)
        vs = vcm - m1.vgs
    mt = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, it, vds=max(vs, 0.12))
    m8 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, i7, vds=vcm)

    gm7 = m7.gm
    rz = p["rz_k"] * (1 + CL / cc) / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m4.gds + m1.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    psrr_db = db(A1 * A2 * (m7.gds + m8.gds) / m7.gds) - 6
    cmrr_db = db(2 * gm1 * m3.gm / (mt.gds * (m4.gds + m1.gds))) - 3
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd + 5e-15
    C2 = CL + m8.cdd + m7.cdd
    wp2 = gm7 * cc / (C1 * C2 + cc * (C1 + C2))
    wp3 = 1.0 / (rz * C1)
    dz = rz - 1.0 / gm7
    wz = 1.0 / (cc * dz) if abs(dz) > 1e-9 else 1e15
    wm = m3.gm / (m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd)
    wc = 2 * PI * ugbw
    ph = 90 + math.degrees(math.atan(wc / wp2) + math.atan(wc / wp3) + math.atan(wc / wm)
                          - math.atan(wc / (2 * wm)) - math.atan(wc / wz) * (1 if dz > 0 else -1))
    pm = 180 - ph + 10
    slew = 0.8 * min(it / cc, i7 / (CL + cc))
    settle = 0.5 * (0.5 / slew + 4.6 / wc)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i7)
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300.15
    s_th = 2 * kT4 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m4.gm / gm1)
    KFn, KFp = 2.5e-10, 0.8e-10
    s_fl = 2 * (KFn / (m1.W * m1.L * 1e3) + (m4.gm / gm1) ** 2 * KFp / (m4.W * m4.L * 1e3))
    noise = 1.7 * math.sqrt(s_th + s_fl)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "psrr_db": psrr_db, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "slew": slew,
               "settle": settle, "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise}
```
